name: Missouri

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and blue, with the state coat of arms in the center inside a blue ring of 24 white stars.
flag.symbolism: The 24 stars show that Missouri was the 24th state; the two grizzly bears holding the shield stand for strength and bravery.

hook: Missouri is a red-white-blue tricolor with two grizzly bears holding a shield in the middle, ringed by 24 stars.
trivia: It was designed by Marie Elizabeth Watkins Oliver and adopted in 1913.
The Roman numerals MDCCCXX under the arms give 1820, the year Missouri's constitution was written.
